test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:
"A person who pretends to have moral beliefs they don't actually possess ____".
solution: The correct answer is: **Hypocrite**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The word **"Hypocrite"** refers to a person who pretends to have higher standards or more noble beliefs than is the case. (पाखंडी) • **Example:** He was called a hypocrite for preaching about honesty while secretly being involved in corrupt practices. • This term is often used to describe individuals who criticize others for behavior they themselves exhibit. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Hypocrite**.
